title: Interior lab scene with DREAMLab sign, students and equipment
objects_and_counts: 10 people are visible and individually distinguishable: one seated person at left edge using a workstation, one standing adult-sized person at left foreground speaking, one person leaning over the central table working with tools, and a group of seven students standing to the right of the central table (some students are partially obscured by others and by foreground objects).

At least five computer monitors are visible: a bank of monitors along the left wall (four visible) and one or two monitors on the central rear desk (counts stated as at least five because some are partially obscured).
At least six rolling office chairs are visible around the central tables and workstations (several chairs are partially obscured by people and by the table edges).

Two small tracked robots or robot chassis are visible on the floor near the central-left area in front of the workstations; one has a white panel with a black numeral '1' on it (the robots are partly obstructed by chairs and the standing person).

One cardboard box standing upright on the central table with legible handwritten numerals, and multiple electronic components, cables and tools scattered on the central table (these are visible as assembled clusters but individual small items are not counted).
A blue cloth bag is held by a student at right foreground and other personal bags/backpacks are visible on or near the students (counts of small personal items not exhaustively enumerated).
